method.value: Full LTE model for all identified species; population diagrams for rotational temperatures

evidence.quote: we can account for this contamination thanks to our full LTE model that contains all species identified so far.

evidence.quote: the model assumes a source size of 1.20$\ensuremath{''}$, a rotational temperature of 150 K, a linewidth of 5.0 km s$^{-1}$

results_numeric.quantity: Column density of each doubly 13C isotopologue

claims.hypothesis: Doubly 13C ethyl cyanide isotopologues are detectable in EMoCA data
claims.experiment: Lab spectroscopy then LTE modelling of the ALMA spectrum of Sgr B2(N2)
claims.result: About 8, 7 and 8 clean lines detected for the three species

evidence.quote: All three species are unambiguously detected in our ALMA data.

limitations_admitted.value: Rotational temperatures of the doubly 13C species are poorly constrained, and uniform source structure assumed

evidence.quote: Their rotational temperatures are thus poorly constrained
